import MumfordLib.SimplicialCohomologyConnecting
import MumfordLib.SimplicialCupLeibniz

/-!
# Cup products and Mayer--Vietoris connecting representatives

Every overlap cocycle admits a lift to the two cochain groups. The differentials
of the lift glue to a union cocycle representing its connecting class.
Multiplication by a global cocycle gives a lift of the cup product; the signed
Leibniz identity computes its connecting representative.

This supplies the cochain sign calculation for Mumford, Chapter I, Section 1,
integral cohomology and its circle-product induction.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open CategoryTheory

namespace Mumford.Analytic

/-- The Alexander--Whitney product of two simplicial cocycles. -/
def simplicialCocycleCup {K : SSet} {p q n : ℕ}
    (φ : simplicialCocycles K p) (ψ : simplicialCocycles K q) (h : p + q = n) :
    simplicialCocycles K n :=
  ⟨simplicialCochainCup φ.1 ψ.1 h, simplicialCochainCup_cocycle φ.1 ψ.1 φ.2 ψ.2 h⟩

/-- Pullback of a simplicial cocycle. -/
def simplicialCocyclePullback {K L : SSet} (f : K ⟶ L) (n : ℕ)
    (φ : simplicialCocycles L n) : simplicialCocycles K n :=
  ⟨simplicialCochainPullback f n φ.1, by
    change simplicialCochainDifferential K n (simplicialCochainPullback f n φ.1) = 0
    rw [← simplicialCochainPullback_differential, φ.2, map_zero]⟩

/-- Every overlap cocycle lifts to a pair of cochains whose differentials
are the restrictions of a union cocycle. -/
theorem simplicialCocycle_exists_mayerVietoris_lift {K : SSet}
    (A B : K.Subcomplex) (n : ℕ) (γ : simplicialCocycles (A ⊓ B : K.Subcomplex) n) :
    ∃ (α : IntegralSimplicialCochain A n) (β : IntegralSimplicialCochain B n)
      (θ : simplicialCocycles (A ⊔ B : K.Subcomplex) (n + 1)),
      simplicialCochainIntersectionDifference A B n (α, β) = γ.1 ∧
      simplicialCochainUnionRestriction A B (n + 1) θ.1 =
        (simplicialCochainDifferential A n α, simplicialCochainDifferential B n β) := by
  obtain ⟨⟨α, β⟩, hγ⟩ := simplicialCochainIntersectionDifference_surjective A B n γ.1
  have hclosed : simplicialCochainIntersectionDifference A B (n + 1)
      (simplicialCochainDifferential A n α, simplicialCochainDifferential B n β) = 0 := by
    change simplicialCochainPullback _ (n + 1) (simplicialCochainDifferential A n α) -
      simplicialCochainPullback _ (n + 1) (simplicialCochainDifferential B n β) = 0
    rw [simplicialCochainPullback_differential, simplicialCochainPullback_differential,
      ← map_sub]
    change simplicialCochainDifferential _ n
      (simplicialCochainIntersectionDifference A B n (α, β)) = 0
    rw [hγ]
    exact γ.2
  obtain ⟨θ, hθ⟩ := (simplicialCochainMayerVietorisDegree_exact A B (n + 1) _).mp hclosed
  have hθclosed : simplicialCochainDifferential (A ⊔ B : K.Subcomplex) (n + 1) θ = 0 := by
    apply simplicialCochainUnionRestriction_injective A B (n + 2)
    rw [map_zero]
    apply Prod.ext
    · change simplicialCochainPullback (SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE le_sup_left) (n + 2)
        (simplicialCochainDifferential _ (n + 1) θ) = 0
      have hA := congrArg Prod.fst hθ
      change simplicialCochainPullback (SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE le_sup_left)
        (n + 1) θ = simplicialCochainDifferential A n α at hA
      rw [simplicialCochainPullback_differential, hA, simplicialCochainDifferential_squared]
    · change simplicialCochainPullback (SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE le_sup_right) (n + 2)
        (simplicialCochainDifferential _ (n + 1) θ) = 0
      have hB := congrArg Prod.snd hθ
      change simplicialCochainPullback (SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE le_sup_right)
        (n + 1) θ = simplicialCochainDifferential B n β at hB
      rw [simplicialCochainPullback_differential, hB, simplicialCochainDifferential_squared]
  exact ⟨α, β, ⟨θ, hθclosed⟩, hγ, hθ⟩

/-- Multiplication by a union cocycle carries a connecting representative to
the cup representative, with the sign of the degree of the left factor. -/
theorem simplicialCohomologyMayerVietorisConnecting_cup_left_of_lift
    {K : SSet} (A B : K.Subcomplex) (p q : ℕ)
    (φ : simplicialCocycles (A ⊔ B : K.Subcomplex) p)
    (γ : simplicialCocycles (A ⊓ B : K.Subcomplex) q)
    (α : IntegralSimplicialCochain A q) (β : IntegralSimplicialCochain B q)
    (θ : simplicialCocycles (A ⊔ B : K.Subcomplex) (q + 1))
    (hγ : simplicialCochainIntersectionDifference A B q (α, β) = γ.1)
    (hθ : simplicialCochainUnionRestriction A B (q + 1) θ.1 =
      (simplicialCochainDifferential A q α, simplicialCochainDifferential B q β)) :
    simplicialCohomologyMayerVietorisConnecting A B (p + q)
      (simplicialCohomologyClass _ (p + q)
        (simplicialCocycleCup
          (simplicialCocyclePullback
            (SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE (inf_le_left.trans le_sup_left)) p φ) γ rfl)) =
      (-1 : ℤ) ^ p • simplicialCohomologyClass _ (p + q + 1)
        (simplicialCocycleCup φ θ (by omega)) := by
  let φA := simplicialCocyclePullback (SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE
    (le_sup_left : A ≤ A ⊔ B)) p φ
  let φB := simplicialCocyclePullback (SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE
    (le_sup_right : B ≤ A ⊔ B)) p φ
  let φAB := simplicialCocyclePullback (SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE
    (inf_le_left.trans le_sup_left : A ⊓ B ≤ A ⊔ B)) p φ
  let χ := simplicialCocycleCup φ θ (by omega : p + (q + 1) = p + q + 1)
  have hdiff : simplicialCochainIntersectionDifference A B (p + q)
      (simplicialCochainCup φA.1 α rfl, simplicialCochainCup φB.1 β rfl) =
        (simplicialCocycleCup φAB γ rfl).1 := by
    change simplicialCochainPullback _ (p + q) (simplicialCochainCup φA.1 α rfl) -
      simplicialCochainPullback _ (p + q) (simplicialCochainCup φB.1 β rfl) = _
    rw [simplicialCochainPullback_cup, simplicialCochainPullback_cup]
    change simplicialCochainCup
        (simplicialCochainPullback _ p (simplicialCochainPullback _ p φ.1)) _ rfl -
      simplicialCochainCup
        (simplicialCochainPullback _ p (simplicialCochainPullback _ p φ.1)) _ rfl = _
    rw [← simplicialCochainPullback_comp, ← simplicialCochainPullback_comp]
    change simplicialCochainCup φAB.1 _ rfl - simplicialCochainCup φAB.1 _ rfl = _
    rw [← simplicialCochainCup_sub_right]
    exact congrArg (fun η => simplicialCochainCup φAB.1 η rfl) hγ
  have hlift : simplicialCochainUnionRestriction A B (p + q + 1)
      ((-1 : ℤ) ^ p • χ).1 =
        (simplicialCochainDifferential A (p + q) (simplicialCochainCup φA.1 α rfl),
          simplicialCochainDifferential B (p + q) (simplicialCochainCup φB.1 β rfl)) := by
    apply Prod.ext
    · change simplicialCochainPullback (SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE le_sup_left)
        (p + q + 1) ((-1 : ℤ) ^ p • simplicialCochainCup φ.1 θ.1 (by omega)) = _
      rw [map_smul, simplicialCochainPullback_cup,
        simplicialCochainCup_differential_of_left_cocycle φA.1 α φA.2 rfl]
      have hA := congrArg Prod.fst hθ
      change simplicialCochainPullback (SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE le_sup_left)
        (q + 1) θ.1 = simplicialCochainDifferential A q α at hA
      rw [hA]
      rfl
    · change simplicialCochainPullback (SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE le_sup_right)
        (p + q + 1) ((-1 : ℤ) ^ p • simplicialCochainCup φ.1 θ.1 (by omega)) = _
      rw [map_smul, simplicialCochainPullback_cup,
        simplicialCochainCup_differential_of_left_cocycle φB.1 β φB.2 rfl]
      have hB := congrArg Prod.snd hθ
      change simplicialCochainPullback (SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE le_sup_right)
        (q + 1) θ.1 = simplicialCochainDifferential B q β at hB
      rw [hB]
      rfl
  have hδ := simplicialCohomologyMayerVietorisConnecting_class_of_lift A B (p + q)
    (simplicialCocycleCup φAB γ rfl)
    (simplicialCochainCup φA.1 α rfl) (simplicialCochainCup φB.1 β rfl)
    ((-1 : ℤ) ^ p • χ) hdiff hlift
  exact hδ.trans (map_zsmul
    (simplicialCohomologyClass (A ⊔ B : K.Subcomplex) (p + q + 1)).toAddMonoidHom
    ((-1 : ℤ) ^ p) χ)

/-- For every overlap cocycle, its connecting class has a representative
whose cup with any fixed union cocycle computes the signed connecting cup. -/
theorem simplicialCohomologyMayerVietorisConnecting_exists_cup_left
    {K : SSet} (A B : K.Subcomplex) (p q : ℕ)
    (φ : simplicialCocycles (A ⊔ B : K.Subcomplex) p)
    (γ : simplicialCocycles (A ⊓ B : K.Subcomplex) q) :
    ∃ θ : simplicialCocycles (A ⊔ B : K.Subcomplex) (q + 1),
      simplicialCohomologyMayerVietorisConnecting A B q
          (simplicialCohomologyClass _ q γ) = simplicialCohomologyClass _ (q + 1) θ ∧
      simplicialCohomologyMayerVietorisConnecting A B (p + q)
          (simplicialCohomologyClass _ (p + q)
            (simplicialCocycleCup
              (simplicialCocyclePullback
                (SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE (inf_le_left.trans le_sup_left)) p φ) γ rfl)) =
        (-1 : ℤ) ^ p • simplicialCohomologyClass _ (p + q + 1)
          (simplicialCocycleCup φ θ (by omega)) := by
  obtain ⟨α, β, θ, hγ, hθ⟩ := simplicialCocycle_exists_mayerVietoris_lift A B q γ
  exact ⟨θ, simplicialCohomologyMayerVietorisConnecting_class_of_lift A B q γ α β θ hγ hθ,
    simplicialCohomologyMayerVietorisConnecting_cup_left_of_lift A B p q φ γ α β θ hγ hθ⟩

end Mumford.Analytic
